The record was held from 2026-09-18 until the registry's link check could ask a POST-only surface with a POST (#111)

finding: With no credentials, an MCP initialize POST to mcp.api.coingecko.com/mcp answers 200 (coingecko_coingecko_typescript_api 8.0.0) and issues a session id, and a tools/list on that session answers 200 with two tools: execute, described as running JavaScript code against the CoinGecko API, and search_docs, which searches the SDK documentation. The keyless server therefore exposes the API through one code-execution tool rather than one tool per endpoint, which is a different shape from every other server in this series and one a tool count does not show. No challenge is sent and the RFC 9728 default path answers 404. A keyless GET on the documented REST price endpoint answers 200 with a price. Same 200s as the 2026-09-10 measurement in the entry's notes; the two-tool list and its shape are recorded here for the first time. This probe asks about access; the x402 payment path is probe p-20260911-coingecko-x402-unpaid and was not re-run. Nothing here measures what a tool call returns.
